description: Binance-affiliated companies have filed lawsuits against Hong Kong-based crypto payments firm RedotPay, alleging it diverted customers from Binance Card in breach of a commercial agreement. The lawsuit seeks nearly $473 million in damages, claiming the alleged conduct contributed to RedotPay's rapid growth ahead of a planned IPO. RedotPay has denied the allegations, stating that it will vigorously defend the claims while continuing its normal business operations.
title: Binance Takes RedotPay to Court Over Claimed $473 Million Losses

description: Popular smartphones with advanced rear cameras, bright displays, new gaming features and long battery life are confirmed to be available at reduced prices in the upcoming Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026. Different models, including the Redmi A7 Pro 5G, Samsung Galaxy M17 5G and iQOO Z11 Lite, will be available at discounted rates. Here are some of the best deals on handsets under Rs. 20,000 available in the upcoming sale.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale 2026: Top Smartphone Deals Under Rs. 20,000 Including Galaxy M17 5G, Redmi A7 Pro 5G, and More

description: Galaxy Digital's chief researcher Alex Thorn said at least 15 attackers exploited the Coldcard hardware wallet vulnerability, with total losses now estimated at around $100 million. Thorn said victim reports helped identify multiple attackers that would have otherwise remained anonymous. The findings come after successive waves of coordinated thefts linked to the same flaw, reigniting concerns over hardware wallet security and the growing role of AI in accelerating cyberattacks.
title: Galaxy Research Identifies at Least 15 Attackers Exploiting Coldcard Security Flaw

description: 2K and Hangar 13 have shared a first look at gameplay for Mafia: The Old Country's Man of Honor expansion. The story DLC is launching on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X on August 14. The expansion will add two new story chapters, and new content to the game's Free Ride mode.
title: Mafia: The Old Country's Man of Honor Expansion Gets First Look at Gameplay Ahead of Launch

description: Native, a sub-brand of the homegrown home services platform Urban Company, launched the Native M3 and M3 Pro water purifiers in India on Wednesday. The company claims its new premium RO water purifiers are designed to reduce maintenance costs with filters that last up to three years without requiring routine servicing or replacement. With the native water purifiers, the company advertises savings of up to Rs. 26,000 over nine years.
title: Native by Urban Company M3 Series Water Purifiers Launched in India With Long-Life Filters, Smart Monitoring

description: Huawei has expanded its laptop portfolio in China with the MateBook Pro S, offering several display and storage configurations. The notebook combines a Kirin XE90 processor with HarmonyOS 6.1, a 14.2-inch Flexible OLED touchscreen and AI-powered software features. It also includes dual 1080p cameras, Bluetooth 6.0, a 54Wh battery with 66W charging support and multiple connectivity features. The MateBook Pro S is available in standard, Soft Light Screen, Privacy Screen and Collector's Edition variants across different colour options.
title: Huawei MateBook Pro S Launched With Kirin XE90 Chipset, 14.2-Inch OLED Display: Price, Features

description: Boltt Ace 5G and Boltt Evo names have been confirmed by the tech firm. Apart from this, the company has revealed the design of the two upcoming handsets, which will mark Fire-Boltt's entry into the country's smartphone market. The Boltt Ace 5G is shown to sport a rectangular rear camera module, with four cutouts placed in the top-left corner of the flat panel. The centred Boltt branding will be placed at the bottom of the panel. The smartphone appears in a red colourway. The Boltt Evo appears in a light blue shade, sporting a similar flat rear panel.
title: Boltt Ace 5G, Boltt Evo Monikers Confirmed as Firm Reveals Design, Colourways Ahead of India Launch

description: A new report suggests Samsung is preparing to expand its inkjet lens printing process on the Galaxy S27 Ultra after introducing the technology on this year's Galaxy S26 Ultra. The technique is expected to replace part of the conventional light-blocking film with matte ink inside the lens assembly to reduce internal reflections and make the camera module thinner. The report also identifies the lens elements expected to use the process and reiterates earlier rumours surrounding the Galaxy S27 Ultra's rear camera system.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra Could Get Thinner Camera Module With Inkjet Printing

description: Samsung executive reveals why Galaxy AI is moving beyond apps and why India is the hard part. Speaking at an AI roundtable, Jay Kim, Corporate EVP and Head of the Customer Experience Office at Samsung's MX Division, answered Gadgets 360's query, which was about India and Galaxy AI's next phase.
title: Exclusive: Samsung’s Next Galaxy AI Challenge: Less Typing, More Agents

description: Amazon has revealed an early Hero Deal for the OnePlus 15 ahead of the Great Freedom Sale. The teaser points to a discounted effective price with a bank offer, while the retailer has also confirmed additional benefits such as HDFC Bank instant discounts, Amazon Pay ICICI Bank cashback, no-cost EMI options and exchange offers. The flagship smartphone features a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, a 165Hz AMOLED display, triple 50-megapixel rear cameras and a 7,300mAh battery.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale: This Is the OnePlus 15 Deal You Can’t Miss

description: Google started informing users that Google Assistant will shut down on Android smartphones on September 4, 2026. The transition will roll out gradually over weeks. The move follows Google's announcement from last year. Gemini will replace Google Assistant across its ecosystem. Gemini can be used to set timers, answer questions, and control smart home devices. Users can access it to control music playback and take actions from their lock screen.
title: Google Assistant Set to Disappear From Android Phones Next Month; Gemini Will Replace It

description: The Itel Ace 3 Heera feature phone has been launched in India with a 1,000mAh battery. It has a 1.8-inch display. The battery is advertised to offer up to 9.64 hours of talktime and up to 177 hours of standby time on a single charge. It is priced at Rs. 949 in India and is offered in Black, Blue and Purple colour options.
title: Itel Ace 3 Heera Feature Phone Launched in India With Up to 9.64 Hours Battery Life: Price, Specifications

description: Bitcoin traded above $64,000 on Wednesday as easing geopolitical tensions and lower oil prices improved investor sentiment. Analysts said subdued spot-market activity and cautious derivatives positioning continue to limit gains, while traders await Friday’s US employment report for fresh direction.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $64,000 as Lower Oil Prices Boost Crypto Sentiment

description: The CMF Clip Pro combines an open-ear design with a customisable charging case, AI-powered calling tools and Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity. The earbuds support LDAC streaming, Google Fast Pair, Microsoft Swift Pair and companion app controls, while the battery is claimed to last up to 32.5 hours with the charging case. The model will debut in select markets before a wider global rollout.
title: CMF Clip Pro Open-Ear Earbuds Launched With LDAC, Up to 32.5 Hours Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Apple reportedly opened a lottery programme for US retail employees interested in helping at its upcoming iPhone launch event. The memo, allegedly shared by Apple with retail staff, suggests the event will take place during the first half of September. Selected employees will help manage attendee queues, check in guests, greet visitors, and provide directions.
title: Apple Launches Lottery for Retail Staff Ahead of September iPhone Launch Event: Report

description: EA has shared a deep-dive on the new open-world mode coming to EA Sports FC 27. The Grounds mode will be availabel to players on PC, PS5, Xbox Series S/X, and Switch 2. EA Sports FC 27 will launch on September 25, 2026. Ultimate and Ultimate Plus editions will come with seven-day early access.
title: EA Sports FC 27 Is Getting a New NBA 2K-Style Open World Mode Called 'The Grounds'

description: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 V Series (SM8850-1-AB) chipset is confirmed to launch with the Redmi K100 Pro next week. A detailed look at the specifications of the upcoming chipset shows that it has one less Adreno GPU slice and lower cache capacity compared to the flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chip. Further, the SM8850-1-AB has an Adreno High Performance Memory of 12MB, compared to 18MB on the standard Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5.
title: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 V Series to Offer a Reduced GPU Compared to the Standard Variant

description: A new leak has shared extensive details about the Google Pixel Watch 5 ahead of its expected launch. The report points to two size options, a Snapdragon W5 Gen 2 chipset, Wear OS 7, 64GB storage and slightly larger batteries. It also outlines Gemini-powered software features, health tracking capabilities, colour options, retail box contents and pricing across multiple markets. The smartwatch is expected to debut alongside the Pixel 11 series at Google's Made by Google event on August 12.
title: Google Pixel Watch 5 Leak Suggests Price, Colourways and Features Ahead of Launch

description: Budget smartphones aren’t exactly high on value in 2026 thanks to the ongoing memory crisis. With price tags of memory creeping higher, manufacturers have their hands tied in terms of upgrades and focus more on the experience. Realme has gone a step further and managed to deliver a massive silicon-carbon battery in a budget device. We take a closer look.
title: Realme P4R Review: Big Battery on a Budget

description: Airtel has discontinued its Rs. 299 prepaid recharge pack. The plan used to offer unlimited calling, unlimited data, and 1GB per day 5G and 4G data quota, while having a validity of 28 days. Moreover, it offered a quota of 100 SMS text messages per day, free caller tunes, and a Perplexity Pro AI subscription. This means that the Rs. 349 recharge plan is now Airtel’s most affordable prepaid recharge pack in the country. The plan offers unlimited local and STD calls, unlimited with a 2GB per day data quota, and a 100 SMS text messages daily quota.
title: Airtel Discontinues Rs. 299 Prepaid Recharge Pack Nearly One Year After Price Hike

description: Realme 16x 5G will launch on August 12 at 12 pm IST. It is confirmed to go on sale via Flipkart and the Realme India website in Endurance Brown and Glory White colourways. It is teased to feature a 7,000mAh battery with support for 45W fast charging. It has a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 processor coupled with 256GB of onboard storage. It will have a 50-megapixel rear camera unit and IP65-rated dust and water resistance.
title: Realme 16x 5G India Launch Date Announced; Teased to Feature MediaTek Dimensity 6300 SoC, 7,000mAh Battery

description: Android 17-based ColorOS 17 will not be available for the OnePlus 10 series. The OnePlus 10 Pro, OnePlus 10T, and OnePlus 10R, originally launched with Android 12, will not receive the Android 17 update. Therefore, they won't be part of the transition to ColorOS 17. Select Nord series smartphones, OnePlus Pad and the OnePlus Pad Go are also expected to miss out on the Android 17 update.
title: OnePlus ColorOS 17 Update: Here's the List of Unsupported OnePlus Devices

description: Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold has appeared in a leaked marketing poster online, which suggests that the Pixel Glow feature will  be marketed by the tech giant as "HiLight". The image also reveals that the “HiLight” feature will allow Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold users to “stay informed” even when their smartphone is lying face down. “When your smartphone is face down, HiLight discreetly illuminates when your favorite contacts call you, or you chat with Gemini,” (translated from French) the leaked poster says.
title: Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold Leak Suggests That the Pixel Glow Feature Will Launch as ‘HiLight’

description: The Amazon Freedom Sale in India is all set to begin soon. Ahead of the sale event, the e-commerce giant has begun revealing some of the exciting deals that will be in store for customers. Shoppers who want to purchase a flagship handset will be able to do so at considerably lower prices than their usual market rates. One such offer on the iQOO 15 has been revealed, which will be available at a lower price through a combination of bank and coupon offers during the sale.
title: Amazon Great Freedom Sale: iQOO 15 to Get Discounted With Bank and Coupon Offers

description: Battlefield maker Electronic Arts has announced the completion of its acquisition by private equity firm Silver Lake, Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, and American investment firm Affinity Partners. The company has now gone private and has been delisted from NASDAQ. The $55 billion leveraged buyout deal was announced in September 2025.
title: EA Announces Completion of Acquisition by PIF, Silver Lake and Affinity Parters as New Owners Commit to AI

description: WhatsApp on Tuesday announced several new features to make coordination easier for larger group chats. Among the new additions is enhanced polls, allowing users to toggle vote deadlines and send anonymous responses. They will also be able to alert everyone in a group chat about time-sensitive messages at once using a new tagging feature. Meanwhile, new group chats on WhatsApp can now be created quickly with people from an existing one.
title: WhatsApp Rolling Out Poll Deadlines, Smarter Mentions and New Group Chat Creation Features

description: Lenovo has disclosed more details about the Legion Y700 AI as it prepares to introduce the gaming tablet in China. The latest announcement confirms its compact dimensions and symmetrical display bezels, while previously revealed specifications include an OLED panel with a 165Hz refresh rate, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Leading Version chipset, LPDDR5T RAM and UFS 4.1 Pro storage. Leaks also point to multiple storage options, a 50-megapixel rear camera, SIM support, 5G connectivity and RGB lighting.
title: Lenovo Legion Y700 AI Design and Dimension Details Revealed Ahead of China Launch

description: With just a week to go for the launch of the Redmi K100 series in China, more details about the upcoming handsets are beginning to surface. Ahead of its anticipated debut on August 11, the Xiaomi sub-brand has confirmed the battery, charging, and camera specifications of the Redmi K100 Pro, which is expected to debut alongside the Redmi K100 Pro Max. The upcoming handset will feature an 8,000mAh-class battery and sport a 200-megapixel primary rear camera.
title: Redmi K100 Pro to Pack 8,580mAh Si-C Battery; Camera Specifications Confirmed Ahead of Launch

description: iQOO Z11, which is set to arrive in India as the third iQOO Z11 series phone, will be launched in India in August, iQOO India’s Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Nipun Marya has confirmed. The new teaser also hints that the India launch of the upcoming smartphone could take place at the end of the month, as the countdown stops briefly on August 27. However, the company has yet to officially confirm the exact launch date, which remains under wraps. Recently, the company executive unveiled the design and colour options of the iQOO Z11, which is set to launch in India as the third iQOO Z11 series smartphone.
title: iQOO Z11 Confirmed to Launch in India This Month With a Redesigned Rear Camera Module

description: Apple has been rumoured to mark the iPhone's 20th anniversary with one of the biggest design overhauls in years. The handset, which is expected to debut as the iPhone 20, is believed to launch in 2027. While the Cupertino-based tech giant remains tight-lipped about its in-development devices, a tipster has suggested that Apple is currently prototyping two new display sizes, including a 6.4-inch panel that could debut on the purported iPhone 20 Pro.
title: Apple 20th Anniversary iPhone Models Tipped to Get Larger Displays, Curved Borderless Design

description: The Oppo F33 Series 5G was launched in India in April, and its successor could already be on the cards. A fresh report suggests that the company is gearing up to launch the Oppo F35 series in the country. While details officially remain under wraps, the lineup is expected to include the Oppo F35 Pro. It will reportedly arrive as a rebadged version of the recently launched China-exclusive Oppo A7 Pro Max, but with a few market-specific tweaks.
title: Oppo F35 Pro Reportedly Set for India Launch This Month With Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 Chip, 10,000mAh Battery

description: Telegram was briefly taken down by Apple from the App Store after a "takedown extortionist" planted illegal pornographic content in a public chat, Telegram’s Chief Executive Officer (CEO), Pavel Durov, revealed on Tuesday. Durov explained that the attacker tricked Telegram’s moderation tools by using the platform’s message-editing functionality, calling this a “technical trick”. The attacker “planted” AI-modified pornographic content by editing an old message in “an active group chat”. Hence, other members of the group were unable to see and report the illegal content. He said that takedown extortionists use automated accounts to post illegal content in public groups.
title: Apple Briefly Took Down Telegram From App Store After a User ‘Planted’ Pornographic Content in a Public Chat
